texts.preamble: Sri Ganesh Cottage Industries, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 29 April, 2024 Aphc010342772020 In The High Court Of Andhra Pradesh At Amaravati [3329] (Special Original Jurisdiction) Monday ,The Twenty Nineth Day Of April Two Thousand And Twenty Four Present The Honourable Sri Justice Venkateswarlu Nimmagadda Writ Petition No: 22733/2020 Between: Sri Ganesh Cottage Industries, ...Petitioner And The State Of Andhra Pradesh and Others ...
texts.facts: - This writ petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of the India seeking the following reliefs:- "to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus declaring the notification No.318/FSSA/AP/2014-20, dated 08.01.2020, published on 10.01.2020 issued by respondent Nos.1 and 3 as being illegal, arbitrary, Sri Ganesh Cottage Industries, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 29 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74018620/ 1 unconstitutional, ultravires the cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003, in violation of principles of natural justice and in violation of Articles 14, 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India and consequently to [LEAKAGE_MASK] the same and direct the respondents not to interfere in any manner with the trade and business carried out in the production that fall within the said notification by the petitioner, their personnel and the persons/entitles to whom they supply those products and pass such other orders ..." 2. When the matter is taken up for hearing, it is observed from the docket sheet that on 22.04.2024, there was no representation on behalf of the petitioner and the matter is posted to today under the caption 'For Dismissal'.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned Government Pleader for the respondents submits that the petitioner is challenging the notification dated 08.01.2020 issued by respondent Nos.1 and 3 herein and in similar circumstances the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court has passed a common order dated 24.03.2023 in W.P.No.30185 of 2021 and batch, wherein it is held as follows: "34. 35. Ex Consequenti, it is declared that the Commissioner of Food Safety, Andhra Pradesh is neither authorized nor having any jurisdiction to issue the impugned notification, prohibiting the manufacture, storage distribution, transportation and sale of Gutka/Pan Masala which contains Tobacco and Nicotine as ingredients and Chewing Tobacco products, within the meaning of Sections 3(m) and 3(p) of the COTPA, 2003, in exercise of powers under Section 30(2)(a) of the FSSA, 2006. 36.
